Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Contract-based role for UiPath via Flow Automations – Hybrid 
 Location: Bucharest, Romania (Hybrid – 3 days/week in the office)
 Contract Duration: 12 months
 Expected Start Date: February 2027
 We are looking for an experienced Senior / Principal Business Intelligence (BI) Developer to support UiPath in building, optimizing, and delivering impactful business intelligence solutions.
 This is a hands-on role requiring strong expertise in Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and SQL , combined with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable data models, insightful dashboards, and actionable reporting solutions.
 You will take ownership of BI initiatives end-to-end, collaborating with technical teams and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, high-quality analytics that support data-driven decision-making.
 What You Will Be Doing 
 BI Development & Reporting: Design, develop, optimize, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports that provide meaningful business insights.
 Microsoft Fabric: Work with Microsoft Fabric to support data integration, transformation, and analytics solutions.
 SQL & Data Processing: Write and optimize complex SQL queries, support data integration processes, and ensure efficient data retrieval and transformation.
 Data Modeling: Design, develop, and optimize data models using best practices, including star schema, snowflake schema, and dimensional modeling.
 Advanced Power BI Development: Leverage DAX, Power Query, and data transformation techniques to deliver accurate, scalable, and performant reporting solutions.
 Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with business and technical stakeholders to understand reporting requirements, define KPIs, and translate business needs into effective BI solutions.
 End-to-End Ownership: Manage BI deliverables throughout the development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and solution design to implementation, testing, and ongoing improvements.
 Data Storytelling: Present complex data and analytical findings in a clear, accessible way, enabling stakeholders and senior leadership to make informed decisions.
 What You Will Bring 
Strong, hands-on experience in Business Intelligence development , ideally within complex corporate or enterprise environments.
 Advanced Power BI expertise , including dashboard development, data visualization, DAX, Power Query, and performance optimization.
 Practical experience with Microsoft Fabric and its data analytics capabilities.
 Strong SQL skills , including complex queries, data transformations, and query optimization.
Solid understanding of data modeling principles , relational databases, and data integration processes.
Experience designing and delivering BI solutions independently, from initial requirements through deployment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex datasets into actionable insights.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
A proactive, detail-oriented mindset and the ability to manage priorities in a dynamic environment.
 Fluent English , both written and spoken.
 Nice to have
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300).
Experience with additional BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Qlik, or Looker Studio.
Familiarity with Python or R for data analysis and automation.
Previous experience working with Finance, Go-to-Market, or other business operations teams.
Experience working in SaaS or enterprise technology environments.
 Additional Information 
 At Flow Automations , we collaborate with enterprise clients and strategic partners such as UiPath , connecting experienced professionals with high-impact technology projects.
 This opportunity offers the chance to contribute to business intelligence and analytics initiatives within a globally recognized automation and AI technology company.
 You will work in a collaborative environment where technical expertise, independent problem-solving, and the ability to turn data into business value are highly appreciated.
 If you have strong expertise in Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and SQL, and enjoy taking ownership of challenging BI projects, we'd love to hear from you.
